brief.headline: Russia claims Kyiv exhibition strike, port campaign; drones hit Wildberries
brief.lead: The monitored channels celebrated a ballistic strike on a Kyiv-area weapons exhibition and an intensifying campaign against Ukrainian ports, while grudgingly reporting a mass Ukrainian drone raid on Wildberries warehouses and warehouses across western Russia. Tone was broadly triumphant (60% positive) but laced with unusually sharp criticism of Russian command over drone-defence failures.

developments.title: Ballistic strike claimed on Kyiv-area weapons exhibition
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed a midday Russian ballistic strike hit a Ukrainian drone/weapons exhibition near Kyiv reportedly attended by defence-industry officials and developers; Kotsnews cited at least 10 killed and 100+ wounded, WarGonzo alleged two Zircon and eight Iskander missiles were used. Casualty and munitions figures are unconfirmed channel claims.

developments.title: Port strike campaign claims 21 vessels, shipping exits
developments.body: Rybar claimed the campaign against Ukrainian ports has confirmed hits on 21 vessels, with Maersk suspending operations; Two Majors added Allseeds, ADM and Kernel halting activity at Yuzhny. Channels reported fuel-storage and infrastructure strikes at Odesa, Izmail and Nikolaev — figures MoD-adjacent/unconfirmed.

developments.title: Mass Ukrainian drone raid hits Wildberries warehouses
developments.body: Channels reported a large Ukrainian drone attack targeting Wildberries retail warehouses across Crimea, St. Petersburg/Leningrad, Kirov and Tver; the MoD claim of 571 drones downed was cited by Two Majors and Rybar. WarGonzo reported a strike on a Kirov facility killing 6 and wounding 26. Casualty and interception figures unconfirmed.

developments.title: Claimed frontline gains in Kharkiv, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia
developments.body: Channels claimed the North group liberated Zakharovka and Ivashkino in Kharkiv (defeating Ukrainian 129th/159th brigades), completed capture of Belitskoye in Donetsk with a flag-raising, and consolidated control of Konstantinovka. WarGonzo reported advances near Hulyaipole. All are channel/MoD-sourced and unverified.

developments.title: Milbloggers slam command over drone-defence failures
developments.body: Two Majors accused the military command of excessive bureaucracy and staging fake air-defence posts with unprepared recruits; Kotsnews and Poddubny said Russian government is unprepared for systematic Ukrainian strikes on logistics hubs and marketplaces, urging decentralisation. The criticism topic scored fully negative (net -100).

developments.title: Two claimed FSB/Iraq counterterror foils tied to Ukraine
developments.body: WarGonzo reported the FSB detained a woman planning a car bomb against a security official on alleged Ukrainian orders; Rybar claimed Iraqi forces stopped an attack on the Badra oilfield (30% Gazprom-owned), with the perpetrator recruited via a Ukrainian phone number. Both unverified.

narrative_watch.title: Ports campaign framed as economic strangulation
narrative_watch.body: Channels increasingly frame port strikes and Western shipping withdrawals (Maersk, ADM, Kernel) as choking Ukraine's export economy, reversing earlier internal criticism that Russia spared Ukraine's economy.

narrative_watch.title: Existential war framing
narrative_watch.body: Starshe Eddy recast the war as fought for Russian survival against 'existential Russophobia' rather than economic or territorial gain — a recurring legitimising frame.

narrative_watch.title: Musk cited to normalise territorial concessions
narrative_watch.body: Two Majors amplified Elon Musk's call for a peace deal locking in Russian territorial gains, using a Western figure to legitimise maximalist demands.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant (net +100); Kyiv exhibition strike and port campaign framed as decisive blows to Ukraine's defence industry and exports.
Fully positive; channels claim gains across Kharkiv, Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia axes, though all figures are self-reported and unverified.
Strongly negative (net -78); mass drone raid on Wildberries warehouses and the Kirov strike dominate, softened only by MoD's 571-downed claim.
Notably improved (net +24, up 41); focus on US-Iran tensions, Global South ties and Musk peace talk rather than Ukraine aid grievances.
Modestly positive (net +12, up 32); counterterror wins and drone-defence deployments offset anxiety over surveillance and mobilisation.
Fully negative (net -100); milbloggers hammer command bureaucracy and government unpreparedness for Ukrainian logistics strikes.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO sentiment up 41 points
flag_texts.body: Net sentiment on West & NATO rose to +24, driven by Rybar's coverage of US polling against the Iran war, US base evacuations, and Russian outreach to Indonesia and the Global South — shifting focus away from Western military aid to Ukraine.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal sentiment up 32 points
flag_texts.body: Net sentiment climbed to +12 on claimed FSB and Iraqi counterterror successes and new anti-drone deployments (Leningrad floating platform, contract-soldier training), outweighing negative posts on iPhone surveillance and Alabuga information warfare.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation rumours resurface
flag_texts.body: Two channels touched mobilisation: Two Majors amplified a Duma deputy denying any new wave and distancing the convict-contract law from mobilisation, while WarGonzo highlighted contract-soldier combat training near Moscow — signalling sensitivity to the topic.

flag_texts.title: No criticism of Putin
flag_texts.body: Despite sharp attacks on military command and government drone-defence failures, the monitored channels registered no direct criticism of Putin on the day.
